name: Rin'ji is Trapped!
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Hey friend!

Rin'ji lost axe and was captured! Please, help Rin'ji escape. Me know that friend like you don't like Rin'ji's kind, but Rin'ji begs! Must get out of here!

Got something for nice friend if he helps Rin'ji out of here...

Rin'ji is hiding something secret at the Overlook Cliffs.
narrative.objectives: Escort Rin'ji out of the Quel'Danil Lodge, then find his hidden secret at the Overlook Cliffs to the east.
narrative.offerRewardText:
This troll tablet must be the "secret" that Rin'ji was talking about.

Covered with strange markings, you can not decipher what the tablet says.

Oran Snakewrithe sent you to this area in the first place... Perhaps he might be able to tell you more about it.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests at level 47, 10,500 XP in all.

quests.name: Rin'ji's Secret
quests.objectiveText: Oran Snakewrithe, a well known scholar on matters concerning the Witherbark trolls, may be able to decipher the tablet.
